fullContent:
Lashuna Erandadi Kashayam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sahasrayoga, Kashayam Prakarna 
 Introduction 
 Lashuna Erandadi Kashayam is a liquid herbal formulation. Lashun or Garlic is the main ingredient of this composition. This formulation helps in curing ascites, bloating, flatulence etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Garlic (Allium sativum) 
 Castor (Ricinus communis) 
 Fever nut (Caesalpinia bonducella) 
 Punarnava (Boerhaavia diffusa) 
 East Indian globe thistle (Sphaeranthus indicus) 
 Ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and coarsely grind all the ingredients. Boil all the ingredients in water till the amount is reduced to 1/4th of the actual amount. 
 Dosage 
 5 – 10 ml of this formulation can be mixed with equal amount of water on an empty stomach or as advised by the doctor. This formulation can be taken with a pinch of asafetida. 
 Indications 
 
 Bloating 
 Hernia 
 Strengthens the abdominal muscles 
 Ascites 
 Hydrocele 
 Flatulence 
 Gas distention 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Self-medication is not advised. 
 Over dosage might irritate the gastric mucosa. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
